scope: Initial Explorer subset; other library families and operations are not exposed here.

families.name: Normal
families.support: All real x; mean mu, standard deviation sigma (not variance).

families.name: Exponential
families.support: x >= 0; lambda is a rate in inverse x units (not a scale).

families.name: Poisson
families.support: Integers k >= 0; lambda is the expected count per interval.
